criteria.done: the step did what it was for
criteria.retry: it failed in a way another try could fix
criteria.stuck: the same failure has now happened twice
criteria.refused: the model declined to do legitimate work
criteria.check: it produced something that should be checked before it is relied on

questions.instructions: How did the last model call end?
questions.purpose: Tells the router whether to move on, retry, escalate or send the work to a check.
questions.retirement: Retire if the local rules match this answer's accuracy at the same cost, per the reader test in the paper's section 10 test 1.
questions.name: How the call ended
